question: Why did the error rate go up on 07 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment of auth v2.27 to ap-south
why_chain: auth v2.27 deployment caused the error rate to rise in ap-south.
The error rate increased from 0.49% to 4.43% after the deployment.
The deployment happened 2 minutes before the error rate spike.

contributing_factors.description: Changed auth feature flag to 50% in ap-south
why_chain: Changing the auth feature flag to 50% in ap-south caused the error rate to rise.
The feature flag change happened 3 minutes before the error rate spike.
The feature flag change could have introduced a bug or incompatibility.

ruled_out.hypothesis: More users or requests than usual caused the error rate to rise
ruled_out.reason: The request volume and latency remained stable, contradicting this hypothesis.

ruled_out.hypothesis: An upstream or external service failure caused the error rate to rise
ruled_out.reason: No evidence of a failure in upstream services was found.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Bad or unusual input data caused the error rate to rise
ruled_out.reason: No evidence of unusual input data was found.

ruled_out.hypothesis: No clear evidence of a direct dependency issue
ruled_out.reason: It rests on a change that is too early, or in a different service/region, to explain a sudden change here.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service auth in region ap-south rose from 0.49% to 4.43% (+807%), with a change point at 2026-03-07T07:10:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service auth in region ap-south: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.10).
At the same time, request volume for service auth in region ap-south stayed about the same (223 per 5 min before, 271 per 5 min after, +21%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service auth in region ap-south stayed about the same (91 ms before, 89 ms after, -1%).
Deployed auth v2.27 to ap-south (auth, ap-south; 2 min before the change; record R014; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
Changed auth feature flag new_ui_flow to 50% in ap-south (auth, ap-south; 3 min before the change; record R013; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
High error rate on auth in ap-south (auth, ap-south; 10 min after the change; record R015; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
auth: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v2.27) (auth, ap-south; 19 min after the change; record R016; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
auth: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v2.27) (auth, ap-south; 28 min after the change; record R017; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 3 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✗ 1 other change event(s) fit about as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Roll back the auth v2.27 deployment to ap-south
Review and revert the auth feature flag change to 50% in ap-south
Monitor the system for any further issues and take corrective action as needed
